name: When should I consider adjusting my home's thresholds or adding ramps?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider adjusting my home's thresholds or adding ramps?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider adjusting thresholds or adding ramps if you have uneven flooring transitions, issues with accessibility for family members or guests, or if you're undertaking a renovation project. Common reasons include making your home more wheelchair-friendly, addressing tripping hazards, or creating a seamless transition between indoor and outdoor spaces. Consulting with a general contractor like City Dweller can help determine the best solution for your specific needs and ensure compliance with any relevant building codes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider adjustments for uneven floors, accessibility needs, or during renovations to improve safety and ease of movement.
